_comment: A comparison set must vary exactly ONE parameter. Here that is storageClass.
The previous version of this file varied profile, replicas, file size AND
ALWAYS_SYNC between deployments -- in particular it enabled sync only on
nfs41 -- so any difference it reported could not be attributed to the NFS
version. nifi-multi.sh writes a config_hash next to each CSV and
nififlow.py compare refuses to rank runs whose hashes differ.
For sweeping profiles or sync settings, use deployments-profiles.json:
That is a survey, not a comparison, and must not be quoted as one.
